pages.title: District appropriation return, fiscal year 1899, as published
pages.body: The 1899 return was published in March under the second edition of the standard and came to 61,240 dollars over four districts. It was taken under five headings, appropriated, estimated, recommended, limit and other, and it made no separate return for floating plant. The standard was reissued this summer and the headings changed, so nothing on this page carries over to the current year without being worked again from the pages.

pages.title: Committee papers: what goes in the pack
pages.body: Each return goes to the committee as one page that opens in a browser with no server behind it. It carries the headline total, a bridge from everything printed on the pages down to the total, a split by district, and a table of every line that can be sorted and filtered. Annexes are not read and are no longer accepted.
